function: Excluded for above_phy: the only learned component, a DNN, predicts binary task offloading decisions (p. 6-7); the IRS phase shifts come from the non-learned Whale Optimization Algorithm (p. 9).
notes: Exclusion code above_phy (4). The work (IOPO) is a UAV-based MEC system with an IRS in a THz network. p. 6: "we introduce a deep learning-based offloading decision generation model"; the DNN outputs a probability matrix over the offloading options of each user (local or one of M UAVs), i.e. task offloading, which is above the physical layer. The IRS phase shifts, the only physical-layer variable, are not learned: p. 9: "To address this, we follow [32] to employ the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA)", a non-learned metaheuristic run inside the loop; p. 10: "the DNN offloading decision model fθ is trained in a supervised manner". The abstract and conclusion (p. 1, 15) present IOPO as optimizing the IRS phase shifts too, but only through WOA. The one-stage DDPG that outputs both offloading and IRS phase is a baseline only (p. 10). The reason is above_phy because a learned component exists and acts on task offloading; no_learning would be the alternative only if the offloading DNN were treated as outside the physical-layer method, so the reviewer should confirm. Tables II-IX were opened as PDF images (pp. 11, 14): all report offloading energy cost and overdue statistics.
